1. Introduction & Purpose
This HR Policy Document outlines the guidelines, rules, and procedures governing employment at ABC Company (Pvt.)
Ltd. The purpose of this document is to ensure clarity and transparency in all human resource matters and to provide a
consistent framework for managing employee relations.
This policy applies to all full-time, part-time, contract, and temporary employees of the company. All employees are
expected to read, understand, and comply with the policies set forth in this document.
1.1 Mission Statement
To foster a productive, inclusive, and rewarding work environment where employees can grow professionally while
contributing to the company's success.
1.2 Scope
- All permanent employees (full-time)
- Contract employees (with applicable clauses)
- Interns and trainees (with modified policies)
- Part-time employees (with applicable clauses)

2. Employee Salary Structure
The company follows a structured salary framework designed to attract, retain, and motivate talented professionals.
Salaries are reviewed annually based on performance, market trends, and company performance.
2.1 Salary Grade Structure
Grade Designation Min (PKR) Mid (PKR) Max (PKR)
Grade 1 Intern/Trainee 25,000 35,000 45,000
Grade 2 Junior Engineer 50,000 65,000 80,000
Grade 3 Engineer 80,000 100,000 120,000
Grade 4 Sr. Engineer 120,000 150,000 180,000
Grade 5 Assistant Manager 150,000 185,000 220,000
Grade 6 Manager 220,000 280,000 340,000
Grade 7 Sr. Manager 340,000 400,000 460,000
Grade 8 Director 460,000 550,000 650,000
Grade 9 VP / C-Level 650,000 800,000 1,000,000+
2.2 Salary Components
- Basic Salary: 40-50% of gross salary
- House Rent Allowance (HRA): 15-20% of gross salary
- Conveyance Allowance: 5-10% of gross salary
- Medical Allowance: 5-10% of gross salary
- Utility Allowance: 5% of gross salary

- Conveyance Allowance: 5-10% of gross salary
- Medical Allowance: 5-10% of gross salary
- Utility Allowance: 5% of gross salary
- Provident Fund (Employer Share): 8.33% of basic salary
- EOBI (Employer Share): As per government regulations
2.3 Salary Disbursement
Salaries are disbursed on the last working day of each month via direct bank transfer. In case of holidays, salaries will
be credited on the preceding working day.

3. Working Days & Office Timings
3.1 Weekly Working Schedule
The company operates on a Monday to Friday work schedule (5 days a week).
Day Timing Duration
Monday 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM 9 Hours
Tuesday 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM 9 Hours
Wednesday 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM 9 Hours
Thursday 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM 9 Hours
Friday 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM 9 Hours
Saturday OFF ---
Sunday OFF ---
3.2 Break Schedule
- Lunch Break: 12:30 PM - 01:30 PM (60 minutes)
- Prayer Break: 15 minutes (flexible timing)
- Tea Break: 10 minutes (morning & evening)
3.3 Grace Period
Employees are allowed a grace period of 10 minutes. Arrival after 09:10 AM will be marked as late. 3 late arrivals in a
month will result in a written warning.
3.4 Attendance Policy
- Biometric attendance system is mandatory for all employees.
- Minimum working hours required: 8 hours per day.
- Monthly attendance target: 95% or above.

- Minimum working hours required: 8 hours per day.
- Monthly attendance target: 95% or above.
- Unexcused absenteeism for 3+ consecutive days without notice may result in termination.

5. Bonus & Incentives
5.1 Annual Performance Bonus
Eligible employees (minimum 6 months of service with satisfactory performance) receive an annual performance bonus
based on their performance rating and company profitability.
Rating Bonus % Min (PKR) Max (PKR)
Exceptional (A+) 3 months 50,000 300,000
Excellent (A) 2 months 40,000 200,000
Good (B) 1.5 months 30,000 150,000
Average (C) 1 month 20,000 100,000
Below Avg (D) 0 months --- ---
5.2 Eid Bonus
All permanent employees receive an Eid bonus equivalent to 1 month basic salary before Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha
each year. Employees with less than 3 months of service at the time of Eid are not eligible.
5.3 Project Completion Bonus
Teams or individuals who successfully complete major projects ahead of schedule or with exceptional quality may be
awarded a one-time project completion bonus of 0.5 to 2 months' salary, at the discretion of management.
5.4 Sales Commission

awarded a one-time project completion bonus of 0.5 to 2 months' salary, at the discretion of management.
5.4 Sales Commission
Sales staff are eligible for commission as per their individual sales targets. Commission structure ranges from 2% to 8%
of net revenue generated, as defined in the individual offer letter or sales agreement.

6. Overtime Policy
Overtime work must be pre-approved by the reporting manager or department head. Overtime is compensated either
through additional pay or compensatory time off.
6.1 Overtime Compensation
- Weekday Overtime: 1.5x of hourly basic rate
- Weekend/Holiday Overtime: 2x of hourly basic rate
- Overtime limit: Maximum 20 hours per month
- Compensatory Off: 1 day off for every 8 hours of weekend overtime worked
6.2 Overtime Calculation
Hourly rate = Basic Salary / 30 days / 9 hours. Overtime claims must be submitted with manager approval by the 3rd of
the following month. Claims submitted after the deadline will be processed in the next cycle.

7. Work From Home Policy
The company supports flexible work arrangements under specific circumstances. Work from home is a privilege, not an
entitlement.
7.1 Eligibility
- Employees with minimum 6 months of service
- Satisfactory performance rating (B or above)
- Role suitability (as determined by department head)
- Maximum 2 days per week (Monday & Friday preferred)
7.2 WFH Guidelines
- Must be available on all communication channels during working hours.
- Must attend all scheduled meetings (online or in-office).
- Daily check-in with reporting manager is mandatory.
- Company laptop and internet allowance provided for WFH days.
- Internet allowance: PKR 2,500/month for approved WFH employees.
Page 9/15

8. Code of Conduct
8.1 Professional Behavior
- Maintain professional and respectful behavior at all times.
- Treat all colleagues, clients, and stakeholders with dignity and respect.
- Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.
- Avoid conflicts of interest and disclose any potential conflicts promptly.
8.2 Dress Code
- Monday - Thursday: Business formal (shirt, trousers, formal shoes)
- Friday: Business casual / Traditional (shalwar kameez allowed)
- No jeans, sneakers, or casual attire on any working day.
- ID badge must be worn and visible at all times on premises.
8.3 Disciplinary Actions
- Verbal Warning: Minor first-time offenses.
- Written Warning: Repeated minor offenses or moderate violations.
- Final Warning: Serious violations or continued misconduct.
- Suspension: Pending investigation for serious complaints.
- Termination: Gross misconduct, fraud, harassment, or violence.

9. Termination & Notice Period
9.1 Notice Period by Grade
Grade Level Notice Period Buyout Option
Grade 1-3 1 Month 1 Month Salary
Grade 4-5 2 Months 2 Months Salary
Grade 6-7 3 Months 3 Months Salary
Grade 8-9 3 Months 3 Months Salary
9.2 Resignation Process
- Submit resignation letter to HR and reporting manager.
- Complete notice period or pay buyout amount.
- Return all company assets (laptop, ID, access cards, etc.).
- Full and final settlement within 30 days of last working day.
- Experience letter issued upon successful clearance.
9.3 End of Service Benefits
- Provident Fund: Full employee + employer contribution payable.
- Gratuity: 1 month basic salary per completed year (5+ years).
- Encashment of unused annual leave (up to 14 days).
- Bonus: Pro-rated if terminated mid-year (not for termination for cause).

10. Health & Insurance Benefits
10.1 Medical Insurance
All permanent employees and their immediate family (spouse + 2 children) are covered under the company's group
medical insurance plan.
Benefit Employee Dependents
OPD Coverage PKR 50,000/year PKR 25,000/year
IPD Coverage PKR 500,000/year PKR 250,000/year
Maternity PKR 200,000 N/A
Dental PKR 30,000/year PKR 15,000/year
Eye Care PKR 20,000/year PKR 10,000/year
10.2 Group Life Insurance
All employees are covered under group life insurance equal to 3 times their annual basic salary. This coverage is
provided at no cost to the employee.
10.3 Wellness Programs
- Annual health check-up for all employees (company-sponsored).
- Monthly wellness sessions (mental health, nutrition, fitness).
- Emergency medical fund for critical situations (up to PKR 100,000).

11. Training & Development
11.1 Annual Training Budget
Each department is allocated an annual training budget of PKR 100,000 per employee for professional development.
This includes workshops, certifications, seminars, and online courses.
11.2 Sponsored Education
Employees with 3+ years of service and 'Excellent' performance rating may apply for sponsored higher education
(Masters/PhD). The company covers up to 75% of tuition fees, subject to a bond of 2 years post-completion.
11.3 Internal Training
- Monthly technical training sessions by department heads.
- Quarterly management and leadership workshops.
- Annual company-wide training week with external trainers.
- Mentorship program pairing junior staff with senior leadership.
Page 13/15

ABC Company (Pvt.) Ltd. - HR Policy Document
12. Grievance Handling
12.1 Grievance Procedure
The company follows a 4-step grievance resolution process:
- Step 1: Verbal complaint to reporting manager (resolve within 3 days).
- Step 2: Written complaint to HR department (resolve within 7 days).
- Step 3: Grievance committee review (resolve within 14 days).
- Step 4: Final decision by CEO/MD (resolve within 21 days).
12.2 Anti-Harassment Policy
The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy against workplace harassment of any kind. All complaints are treated
confidentially and investigated promptly. Victims and witnesses are protected from retaliation.
12.3 Whistleblower Protection
Employees who report unethical, illegal, or policy-violating behavior in good faith are protected from any adverse
employment action. Anonymous reporting is available through the HR hotline.

This HR Policy Document is subject to periodic review and may be amended from time to time by the Human Resources
Department with the approval of the Board of Directors. Any changes will be communicated to all employees through
official channels.

1. Purpose
The purpose of this policy is to establish the guidelines and conditions under which employees may
work from home (telecommute). The Company supports flexible working arrangements that maintain
productivity, collaboration, and work-life balance while ensuring business continuity and data
security.
2. Scope
This policy applies to all employees who are approved for remote work, whether on a regular, hybrid,
or temporary basis. Work from home arrangements are a privilege and not an entitlement, and are
subject to the approval of the employee's manager and Human Resources.
3. Eligibility

subject to the approval of the employee's manager and Human Resources.
3. Eligibility
Employees may be eligible to work from home if they meet all of the following criteria:
  The role and job responsibilities can be performed effectively from a remote location.
 The employee has completed the probationary period, unless otherwise approved by
management.
 The employee has a suitable, quiet, and safe home workspace with reliable internet
connectivity.
 The employee has demonstrated satisfactory performance and attendance.
4. Approval Process
Employees must submit a formal request to their direct manager at least five (5) working days in
advance. The request must state the proposed schedule (days and hours) and the expected
duration. Approval is granted in writing by the manager and Human Resources. The Company
reserves the right to approve, modify, or deny any request based on business needs.
5. Working Hours and Availability

 Employees must maintain their contracted working hours and be available during core business
hours.
 Employees must be reachable via phone, email, and approved messaging platforms during

 Any leave, breaks, or changes to the schedule must be recorded in the same manner as
office-based work.
 Overtime requires prior written approval from the manager.
6. Equipment and Technology
The Company will provide the necessary equipment (e.g., laptop, headset) where required.
Employees are responsible for the proper care and security of Company equipment and must report
any loss, theft, or damage immediately. The Company is not responsible for personal internet or
utility costs unless otherwise agreed in writing.
7. Data Security and Confidentiality
  Employees must use Company-approved devices, VPN, and secure connections when
accessing Company systems.

7. Data Security and Confidentiality
  Employees must use Company-approved devices, VPN, and secure connections when
accessing Company systems.
 Confidential information must not be discussed in public spaces or shared over unsecured
networks.
 Workstations must be locked when unattended, and screens must not be visible to third parties.
 All Company data must be stored on Company-approved systems; personal devices must not
be used for Company data.
 Any security incident or suspected breach must be reported to IT immediately.
8. Health, Safety, and Ergonomics
Employees must ensure their home workspace is safe and ergonomically suitable. The Company will
provide guidance on workstation setup. Employees must take regular breaks and inform their
manager of any work-related injury or health concern arising from the home working environment.

Remote employees are expected to deliver the same quality and volume of work as office-based

9. Performance and Supervision
Remote employees are expected to deliver the same quality and volume of work as office-based
employees. Managers will conduct regular check-ins and performance reviews. Failure to meet
performance expectations may result in the withdrawal of the work from home arrangement.
10. Termination or Modification of Arrangement
The Company may modify or terminate a work from home arrangement at any time, with reasonable
notice, based on business requirements, performance issues, or policy violations. Employees may
also request to return to full-time office work at any time.
